_doc: The one recipe for the base A exact-stack draw (A2). Every exact_stack script loads this file; nothing below is typed from memory. Each factor's source and status (VERIFIED in a primary record, INFERRED, or UNVERIFIED) is in out/main/auditbench/nullext/exact_stack_20261114/REGISTRATION.md, table 'Base A's stack'.
label: idt-exact-stack-a2
seed_note: Engine-level seed LLM(seed=seed_from_label(label)), as base A used seed_from_label('auditbench-collect') = 797178342 (collect.log non-default args). No per-request SamplingParams.seed: in vLLM 0.26.0 a per-request generator sends sampling to the PyTorch-native path instead of FlashInfer (topk_topp_sampler.py forward_cuda). The per-row label '<seed_label>|<prompt_id>|<s>' is written into each row as an identifier only.

engine.torch_note: vllm 0.26.0 pins torch==2.11.0, which the image's 2.11.0+cu128 satisfies, so pip keeps it; base A's 'libcudart.so.13' import failure and its NCCL 2.28.9 (the image's nvidia-nccl-cu12) both point to that build. INFERRED.
expected_log_lines: Using FlashInfer for top-p & top-k sampling.
Chunked prefill is enabled with max_num_batched_tokens=16384.
forbidden_log_lines: Falling back to the PyTorch-native implementation

sampling.submission: one LLM.generate call over all 216 cells (SUBMISSION_CHUNK 256 > 216), lora_request=None, use_tqdm=False; text = completion.text.rstrip()
sampling.prompt: tokenizer.apply_chat_template([system prism4, user], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) passed as a text prompt; vLLM 0.26.0 tokenizes it with add_special_tokens=True on top of the template's <|begin_of_text|> (renderers/base.py default_cmpl_tok_params)
